findings.claim: The marketplace ref switch edits only .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Codex reads .agents/plugins/marketplace.json first, whose source is url './' on main. Codex users who ran 'codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode' (README:593, default branch) stay on frozen v1 forever; 'codex plugin marketplace upgrade' only refreshes main.
findings.evidence: cm-main .agents/plugins/marketplace.json: source {source:url,url:'./'}. Rehearsal (temp CODEX_HOME): 'codex plugin list' resolves the plugin from <root>/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json with SOURCE = marketplace root. ADR-0011:31 'On main, edit only .claude-plugin/marketplace.json plugins[0]'.
findings.fix: Step b must also switch the Codex marketplace on main (or tell Codex users to re-add with '@release'), and the smoke job must test the README command 'codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode' with no ref, not only owner/repo@release.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 1e73a13d 2026-05-11 'fix(codex): make plugin discoverable via .agents/plugins/marketplace.json (#525)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'Codex reads MARKETPLACE_MANIFEST_RELATIVE_PATHS = [.agents/plugins/marketplace.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json]'; './' source was silently dropped ('codex plugin marketplace add succeeds with exit 0 but the plugins vec is empty'). REGRESSION_RISK: a wrong source path in the Codex manifest re-breaks #525 silently (exit 0, empty list). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep .agents/plugins/marketplace.json; any new source must be checked with 'codex plugin list' showing the plugin, not just 'marketplace add' exit 0.

findings.claim: 'mode: rollback' is never defined. Claude Code caches by version: a rollback that reuses an older version number serves the stale cached tree, and a new commit with the same version is ignored.
findings.evidence: Rehearsal (temp HOME, claude 2.1.274, local url source ref release): (1) new release commit, same version 2.0.0 -> 'context-mode is already at the latest version (2.0.0)', bundle unchanged. (2) 2.0.1 then rollback commit with version 2.0.0 and new bundle -> 'updated from 2.0.1 to 2.0.0' but cache/2.0.0/server.bundle.mjs still holds the OLD content and gitCommitSha stays c44324b5.
findings.fix: Define rollback as roll-forward: plan.mjs always emits a version higher than the release head, also in rollback mode (e.g. 2.0.2 with the 2.0.0 tree). release.yml fails if the new plugin.json version <= current release head version.
findings.archaeology: No v1 history: v1 has no release branch or rollback. Not a v1 behaviour change.

findings.claim: Smoke runs after publish against @release. A failed smoke means users already received the broken commit; there is no gate and no stated auto-rollback.
findings.evidence: ADR-0013:38-39 publish then smoke from '@release'. Rehearsal: 'claude plugin marketplace add' succeeded with a manifest that 'claude plugin validate' rejects ('plugins.0.source: Invalid input'); install then failed. So a bad tree is only caught at install time.
findings.fix: Push to a staging ref (e.g. release-next) inside the same run, smoke from it, then fast-forward release. Detection: smoke job status; rollback: roll-forward run as above.

findings.claim: Trigger conflicts: ADR-0011 'triggered by tag v2.* or by hand'; ADR-0013:16 'the owner's signed tag can be the trigger'; ADR-0013:31,61 'workflow_dispatch only', 'No signed tags'.
findings.fix: Make ADR-0011 step 0 and the ADR-0013 facts row say workflow_dispatch only.

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC uses 'latest #release tag' for doctor D1 and ctx_upgrade; ADR-0010:28 says 'latest release commit' and ADR-0011:13 says Codex and Pi see only commits, not tags.
findings.fix: Use the release branch head commit everywhere.

findings.claim: No concurrency rule for release.yml. Two dispatches can race on plan (same version) and on the push to release.
findings.fix: concurrency: {group: release, cancel-in-progress: false}; publish pushes with --force-with-lease against the head plan.mjs read.

findings.claim: 'codex plugin marketplace add owner/repo@ref works with no login' could not be rehearsed offline; the local form rejects file:// URLs and --ref on local paths.
findings.evidence: codex-cli 0.156.1: 'add file://... --ref release' -> 'invalid marketplace source format'; 'add <path> --ref release' -> '--ref is only supported for git marketplace sources'; 'add <worktree path>' -> Added, source_type local; 'marketplace upgrade' -> 'No configured Git marketplaces to upgrade'.
findings.fix: Smoke job must run the network form in CI and assert 'codex plugin list' shows context-mode with the release version.

findings.claim: Skill runs 'npm ci && npm run build' while owner decision says 'no npm for v2'. Reader cannot tell if npm is banned only for distribution or also for dev.
findings.fix: State in ADR-0002/0013 that npm is allowed for dev and CI, banned for end-user install.

covered: doc contradictions on trigger and tag vs commit
